theorems.name: Submission.volume_image_closedBall_le_of_fderiv_not_surjective
theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn m) (x : Rn n) (r η L : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x r, DifferentiableAt ℝ G z) → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x r, ‖fderiv ℝ G z - fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ η) → ‖fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ L → ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G x) → volume (G '' closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (η * r) * (2 * ((L + η) * r)) ^ (m - 1))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
